title: Your First Weekend at Arizona State University Campus Immersion, Shared as Cards
description: Build a plausible under-21-safe first-weekend sequence, not a ranking. Give each card one role in the sequence and use evergreen places or recurring behaviors rather than one-time events. Be conservative about hours, access, and travel time unless directly sourced.

cards.title: Check In at the Student Hub
cards.subtitle: The Living Room of Campus
cards.notes: Visit the MU to find the information desk, grab a meal at the food court, or relax in the lounges. It serves as the central meeting point for new students.
cards.short_summary: The Memorial Union is the central student hub at ASU Tempe, offering dining, meeting spaces, and student services.
cards.evidence_claim: The Memorial Union, known as the MU, is considered the living room of the campus and features dozens of dining options, lounges, and study spaces.
cards.source_title: The Memorial Union | Educational Outreach and Student Services
cards.access_notes: Open daily with extended hours during the academic year; check specific dining venue hours on the ASU website.

cards.title: Walk the Iconic Campus Path
cards.subtitle: A Century-Old Tradition
cards.notes: Stroll down this 0.4-mile pedestrian mall lined with over 100 date palms. It is the most photographed landmark on the Tempe campus.
cards.short_summary: Palm Walk is a famous pedestrian corridor at ASU Tempe, lined with iconic date palms and connecting major campus landmarks.
cards.evidence_claim: Palm Walk is a pedestrian mall on the Tempe campus lined with 110 date palms, running nearly 0.4 miles from University Bridge to the Sun Devil Fitness Complex.
cards.source_title: Palm Walk rehabilitation - ASU Business and Finance

cards.title: Tour the Reinvented Library
cards.subtitle: Academic Heart of Tempe
cards.notes: Explore five floors of study suites, innovation labs, and community book collections. Join a student-led walking tour to learn about research resources.
cards.short_summary: Hayden Library is the main library at ASU Tempe, recently renovated to include modern study spaces and interdisciplinary labs.
cards.evidence_claim: Hayden Library offers ample student space, collaborative study rooms, and interdisciplinary learning labs across a revamped five-story tower.
cards.access_notes: Open daily; ASU ID required for late-night access. Check the library website for current hours.

cards.title: Get Active at the SDFC
cards.subtitle: Wellness and Recreation
cards.notes: Use your student ID to access weight rooms, cardio equipment, and the pool. It's a great place to meet people through intramural sports or group classes.
cards.short_summary: The Sun Devil Fitness Complex (SDFC) provides comprehensive fitness and wellness facilities for ASU students.
cards.evidence_claim: The SDFC is a state-of-the-art fitness facility free for currently enrolled ASU students, featuring cardio equipment, pools, and group wellness classes.
cards.source_title: Sun Devil Fitness - Arizona State University
cards.access_notes: Access is free for enrolled students with a valid Sun Devil ID card.

cards.title: Attend Sun Devil Welcome
cards.subtitle: The Ultimate Spirit Event
cards.notes: Join thousands of first-year students for a high-energy introduction to ASU traditions, featuring the marching band and Sparky the Sun Devil.
cards.short_summary: Mountain America Stadium hosts the annual Sun Devil Welcome, a signature event for all incoming first-year students.
cards.evidence_claim: Sun Devil Welcome is a high-energy event for all ASU first-year students held inside Mountain America Stadium to celebrate spirit and tradition.
cards.access_notes: Event typically held in the evening during Welcome Week; check the ASU Welcome calendar for specific dates.

cards.title: Hike and Paint 'A' Mountain
cards.subtitle: A Rite of Passage
cards.notes: Hike up Hayden Butte to help paint the iconic 'A' white, signaling the start of the new school year. It's one of ASU's oldest traditions.
cards.short_summary: Whitewashing the 'A' is a long-standing tradition where new students hike 'A' Mountain to paint the letter white at the start of the year.
cards.evidence_claim: Whitewashing the 'A' on Hayden Butte is a wrap-up event of Welcome Week where every freshman is invited to paint the 'A' white.
cards.access_notes: The hike is steep; students are encouraged to wear comfortable shoes and bring water.

cards.title: Explore Contemporary Art
cards.subtitle: Free Cultural Experience
cards.notes: Visit the museum to see rotating exhibitions of contemporary art. It's a quiet, air-conditioned space perfect for a weekend afternoon.
cards.short_summary: The ASU Art Museum is a leading contemporary art venue located on the Tempe campus, offering free admission to all visitors.
cards.evidence_claim: Admission to the ASU Art Museum and participation in nearly all of its events and programs is free.
cards.access_notes: Open Wednesday through Sunday, 11 a.m. to 5 p.m. Closed Mondays and Tuesdays.

cards.title: Discover Frank Lloyd Wright Architecture
cards.subtitle: Historic Performing Arts Center
cards.notes: Check out this iconic circular building designed by Frank Lloyd Wright. Look for $10 student tickets for select 'Beyond' series performances.
cards.short_summary: ASU Gammage is a historic theater on the Tempe campus known for its unique architecture and world-class performances.
cards.evidence_claim: $10 student tickets are available for all Beyond performances at ASU Gammage, subject to availability.
cards.access_notes: Box office hours vary; check the website for performance schedules and ticket availability.

cards.title: Find Your Student Club
cards.subtitle: Involvement Fair
cards.notes: Explore hundreds of student organizations at this massive involvement fair. It's the best way to find communities that share your interests.
cards.short_summary: Passport to ASU is a major involvement fair held during Welcome Week where students can explore and join various campus clubs.
cards.evidence_claim: Passport to ASU is the easiest way to explore all the ways to get involved, with clubs gathering around the Memorial Union and Student Pavilion.
cards.access_notes: Typically held on a Friday or Saturday during the first weekend; check the official ASU Welcome schedule.

cards.title: Catch a Game or Event
cards.subtitle: Home of Sun Devil Athletics
cards.notes: Visit the arena for basketball games or university-wide events. It's a central venue for student life and athletic pride.
cards.short_summary: Desert Financial Arena is a multi-purpose indoor arena on the Tempe campus, hosting ASU basketball, volleyball, and major events.
cards.evidence_claim: Desert Financial Arena is the home of Sun Devil Men's and Women's Basketball and hosts various student events throughout the year.
cards.source_title: Desert Financial Arena - Sun Devil Athletics
cards.access_notes: Student tickets are often available through the Sun Devil Rewards app or athletics website.
